competition.title: NFL Lines Lab strategy competition
competition.basis: Score = pre-registered deflated skill × sample-size shrink × calibration factor. Raw win rate is never a ranking input.
competition.rewards: Lab Points and research priority only. No money or prize of monetary value is offered, and no wager is placed or facilitated by this repository.
competition.tieBreak: Higher deflated skill, then larger sample, then better calibration slope.

tiers.A: Tier A — passes every pre-registered gate
tiers.C: Tier C — promising, not yet distinguishable from luck
tiers.D: Tier D — fails at least one gate
